description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format.

evals.name: Mixed types grouped in documented order
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets into release notes:
- feature: add dark mode toggle (#12)
- bug: crash when saving empty note (#15)
- docs: update install guide (#20)
- refactor: split parser module (#21)
- feature: export notes to PDF (#13)
- bug: wrong date shown in footer (#16)
evals.expected_output: Lines grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE with input order kept inside each group: two FEAT lines (#12, #13), two FIX lines (#15, #16), one DOCS line (#20), one CHORE line (#21). Each line is '- [TYPE] Summary (#id)' with sentence-case summary and no trailing period.

evals.name: Bullet without issue number gets (#none)
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets into release notes:
- feature: add keyboard shortcuts (#31)
- bug: fix tooltip flicker
- docs: clarify config options (#33)
evals.expected_output: '- [FIX] Fix tooltip flicker (#none)' is rendered with the literal (#none) marker; the other two lines keep their issue numbers; order is FEAT, FIX, DOCS.
